description: This file defines the 'Download' class, which encapsulates information and actions related to a file download in the Playwright testing framework. It provides methods to access download details, save, cancel, delete, or stream the downloaded file.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Represents a file download, providing access to its properties and actions such as saving, canceling, deleting, or creating a read stream.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page instance associated with the download.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the download.

methods.name: suggestedFilename
methods.description: Returns the suggested filename for the download.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the file path after the download has finished.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the downloaded file to a specified path.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to a failure message if the download failed, or null otherwise.

methods.name: createReadStream
methods.description: Creates a stream to read the downloaded file content.
